articles.headline: Nangongo Primary School Teacher Arrested Over Allegations
articles.preview: A primary school teacher in Machinga has been arrested following allegations of a sexual relationship with a Standard 8 learner.
articles.content: A primary school teacher in Machinga has been arrested following allegations that he had a sexual relationship with a Standard 8 learner. The teacher, identified as Patrick Chitsulo, is reportedly based at Nangongo Primary School in Kayuni Zone. According to the allegations, Chitsulo had a sexual relationship with the learner, who is said to have become pregnant. He is currently in police custody at Nselema Police Station as investigations into the matter continue. The allegations have not yet been tested in court, and the suspect is presumed innocent unless proven guilty.

articles.headline: Promote Teachers Who Excel
articles.preview: Hardworking teachers deserve meaningful career progression, not just certificates.
articles.content: A hardworking teacher should not have to remain on the same grade year after year while their exceptional performance is rewarded with nothing more than a certificate. If a teacher consistently delivers outstanding results, transforms learners' performance and goes beyond the call of duty, that achievement should be recognised through meaningful career progression. Promote teachers who excel. Reward performance with opportunity. When hard work has a clear path to promotion, teachers have a greater incentive to give their best, and the education system stands to benefit.

articles.headline: Duwana wakayamba sukulu yake ku Maranatha Academy
articles.preview: Duwana wakayamba sukulu yake ku Maranatha Academy
articles.content: Duwama Muhammad, msungwana waku Mangochi uja yemwe adalemba yekha mayeso a sitandade 8 pa sukulu ya pulayimale ya Mangale, tsopano wakayamba sukulu yake ku Maranatha Academy. Malingana ndi uthenga omwe a Maranatha Academy atulutsa, msungwanayu achita maphunziro ake kusukuluyi mwa ulele potsatira thandizo la maphunziro lomwe eni sukuluyi adapereka (full scholarship).  Mkulu wa Maranatha Academy Dr. Ernest Kaonga wati sukuluyi ndiyokhudzidwa ndi nkhani ya Duwama komanso mtima wake osagonja.
anatero a Kaonga.  Mbali yake, Duwama wayamikira mwini wake wa Maranatha Academy, Dr. Kaonga kamba komukhulupilira.  by Innocent Kumchedwa.

articles.headline: Honorable Shadric Namalomba officially opened a girls' hostel
articles.preview: Mangochi South East Member of Parliament and Minister of Information Shadric Namalomba has today officially opened a girls' hostel
articles.content: Mangochi South East Member of Parliament and Minister of Information Shadric Namalomba has today officially opened a girls' hostel at Chilipa Community Day Secondary School in Mangochi. Constructed with funding from the Governance to Enable Service Delivery (GESD) programme, the hostel has capacity to accommodate more than 50 girls. The facility is expected to improve girls' access to secondary education by providing accommodation closer to the school, particularly for learners who previously travelled long distances to attend classes.
